DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL)

The combination of severe bone pain, night awakenings, anemia, thrombocytopenia, and significant leukocytosis with normal inflammatory markers in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of ALL.
